analogy.rationale: Mitochondrial electron transport inhibitors collapse the proton gradient and ATP output, so ATPase inhibitors that directly block the mitochondrial ATP synthase share the closest downstream bioenergetic stress signature; oxidative stress inducers overlap through mitochondrial ROS, while HMGCR inhibitors, mTOR inhibitors, and protein synthesis inhibitors share only secondary metabolic/translational stress responses.
